videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Three months after the tragic events involving the sect, the investigation continues. Pieces of the puzzle are missing, frustrating investigators. A young person witnesses an attack online, while he spends his time on “lives”.

videos.title: Responsables
videos.overview: The tragic events involving the sect scarred the community of Sainte-Alice. The families of Jade and Joëlle are trying to recover from this terrible ordeal. The discovery of a mutilated body gives the investigators a hard time.

videos.title: Idées noires
videos.overview: While everyone is worried about Keven, tempers clash between Thomas and Robin. The attentions of Charles-Antoine towards Chris multiply. The lies of Manu's parents continue to complicate things before his release.
